defs.def: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of sth 总体安排；计划；设计

ex.s: This call is open to Burlington-based artists and is open to all art forms that can be presented in a sign format.
ex.t: 本次征集面向伯灵顿本地的艺术家，对所有能以标牌形式呈现的艺术形式开放。

ex.s: Your poem can be any format, any number of lines.
ex.t: 你的诗可以是任何格式任何行数。

ex.s: The format of magazines enables children to be exposed to a wide variety of wide subjects.
ex.t: 杂志的版式使孩子们能够接触到广泛的主题。

ex.s: The format of the ceremony is yet to be decided, and we would like to hear your ideas about the events and performances that could be included.
ex.t: 典礼的形式还有待决定，我们想听听你们对可以包含的活动和表演的想法。

ex.s: Surf the Internet to research different forms of poetry and discover their formats.
ex.t: 上网研究不同形式的诗歌，了解它们的格式。

ex.s: Then use a properemail format with a share in class.
ex.t: 然后使用合适的电子邮件格式并在课堂上分享。

defs.def: the shape and size of a book, magazine, etc. （出版物的）版式，开本

ex.s: Later, it was published in book format and has never been out of print since.
ex.t: 后来，它以书籍的形式出版，自那以后从未绝版。

ex.s: It has a format of three lines, containing 5, 7, and 5 syllables respectively.
ex.t: 它的格式是三行，分别包含5个、7个和5个音节。

defs.def: the way in which data is stored or held to be worked on by a computer 格式
to prepare a computer disk so that data can be recorded on it 格式化
to arrange text in a particular way on a page or a screen 安排版式
